name: Iris
source:
Iris was your judo instructor: demanding, outspoken, and willing to push [url=/c148150]you[/url] harder than you wanted to be pushed. You know what she thought you could achieve. Leaving the sport also meant leaving a part of the relationship you had with her.

[In game description]
